name: Badiul Alam Majumdar
role: Chief of the Election Reform Commission
contribution: He led the Election Reform Commission and helped frame the 2026 election around transparency, procedure, and institutional trust.
context: Election reform debates after the 2024 uprising and before the 13th parliamentary election.
impact: He became a central reform voice shaping election administration and legal debate.
highlight: The reform commission's most visible public face.
